Judge Blocks Trump Administration's Ban on Media Access to White House

A U.S. federal judge, Timothy Kelly, has ordered the White House to restore access for journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, ruling that the Trump administration's ban may have been unlawful. The judge extended an order blocking the ban, which was imposed in September, allowing the reporters continued access to the White House. The ruling comes weeks before the U.S. midterm elections.
